tests.name: inside/outside and inclusive OBB boundaries return exact ascending IDs
margin expands all OBB slabs inclusively
opacity threshold is inclusive at the stored (byte-quantised) value
opacity comparison is inclusive for exactly representable values
empty meshes and zero-size/planar OBBs are safe
invalid callback data is counted and skipped; output is unique and valid
invalid OBBs/options/transforms and LOD/paged inputs reject explicitly
LOD signals other than enableLod are rejected by lifter and mask (mock)
real Apartment-lod.rad is rejected by lifter and mask manager
shader reference changed-pixel count
shader mask equals the equivalent inclusive OBB debug region
negative control with shifted IDs produces a different image
clear and empty replacement restore the exact pixel baseline
mask IDs validate/deduplicate and only changed bytes trigger updates
HoverTint appends and composes after existing modifiers
splat->OBB mapping is correct for distinct splat and OBB poses (with negative controls)
post-selection transforms preserve membership and move the highlight
disposal removes only its modifier, restores pixels, and is idempotent
zero-splat mask creation, invalid replacement and disposal are safe
mask texture layout is correct across 4096-wide row boundaries
Apartment.sog non-LOD scan and mask/render performance

performance.note: submissionMs is needsUpdate/updateVersion CPU work; completed timings include gl.finish(); visible means pixels differ from baseline
